voiceSummary: Hirect Limited has made the audio recording of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call available on its website. The call was held on November 11, 2026. attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Hirect Limited reports highest-ever quarterly and half-yearly revenue, driven by strong business momentum".
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported highest-ever standalone revenue from operations of Rs. 294.3 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 530.7 crore in H1FY27. Consolidated revenue reached Rs. 315.7 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 574.1 crore in H1FY27. Standalone PAT was Rs. 14.5 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 29.6 crore in H1FY27. Consolidated PAT after Minority Interest stood at Rs. 6.8 crore in Q2FY27 and Rs. 16.2 crore in H1FY27. These figures include exceptional gains from the sale of the Dehradun plant. The order book stood at Rs. 795.2 crore as of September 2026. The company received CTC and PICC approvals from Indian Railways and was included in RDSO's UVAM list.

attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website and will be used for an earnings conference call. The company highlighted its evolution into a technology-led systems provider for railway and industrial sectors. Key developments include the acquisition of Elventive France in 2025-26 to establish a European manufacturing footprint for EMS, robotics, and power electronics. Hirect launched commercial production of specialized copper conductors for transformer applications, securing orders from private customers. The company received approvals from Indian Railways for deploying these conductors in traction transformers. The firm operates two manufacturing plants in Nashik and maintains R&D centers in Mumbai and Hyderabad. Leadership includes Chairman and Managing Director Suramya Nevatia and Chief Financial Officer Anil Kumar Nemani.

attchmntText: Hirect Limited has informed the Exchange about issuance of Corporate Guarantee to subsidiary Company
voiceSummary: Hirect Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Net profit was 145.22 million rupees. Revenue from operations was 2,943.47 million rupees. Earnings per share was 3.36 rupees. The board appointed Bigshare Services Pvt. Ltd. as the new Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent, replacing Adroit Corporate Services Pvt. Ltd. The effective date is pending. The board also approved issuing a corporate guarantee or standby letter of credit up to 2 Million EURO for subsidiary Elventive France.
